entries.en: Fixed images pasted while viewing a background agent arriving as the text `[Image #1]`
entries.zh: 修复了查看以文本“[图像 #1]”形式到达的后台代理时粘贴的图像

entries.en: Fixed long background agent and background command results wrapping under the bullet instead of lining up with their text
entries.zh: 修复了长后台代理和后台命令结果包裹在项目符号下方而不是与其文本对齐的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude --worktree` showing nothing while a slow worktree is set up
entries.zh: 修复了设置慢速工作树时`claude --worktree`不显示任何内容的问题

entries.en: Fixed the worktree exit dialog counting a new folder as one uncommitted file
entries.zh: 修复了工作树退出对话框将新文件夹计为一个未提交文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed workflow resume telling Claude every finished agent would be reused after a call failed; Claude is now told how many results were reused and where reuse stopped
entries.zh: 修复了工作流程恢复，告诉克劳德每个完成的代理将在呼叫失败后重新使用；克劳德现在被告知有多少结果被重复使用以及重复使用在哪里停止

entries.en: Fixed a hang on malformed glob patterns in settings, plugin marketplace entries and Grep file filters
entries.zh: 修复了设置、插件市场条目和 Grep 文件过滤器中格式错误的 glob 模式的挂起

entries.en: Fixed plugin and marketplace requests waiting forever when `ALL_PROXY` is the only proxy set and the proxy never answers; they now fail after 25 seconds
entries.zh: 修复了当`ALL_PROXY`是唯一代理集并且代理永远不会应答时插件和市场请求永远等待的问题；他们现在会在 25 秒后失败

entries.en: Fixed the `/` menu, `/skills` and `/plugin` repeating rows and losing the cursor when two skills or commands in one place share a name
entries.zh: 修复了`/`菜单、`/skills`和`/plugin`重复行并在一个位置的两个技能或命令共享名称时丢失光标的问题

entries.en: Fixed search in `/resume`, `/plugin`, `/permissions` and `/config` ignoring IME input, dictation and fast typing
entries.zh: 修复了`/resume`、`/plugin`、`/permissions`和`/config`中的搜索忽略 IME 输入、听写和快速打字的问题

entries.en: Fixed the cursor disappearing after clearing a search on the `/plugin` Installed tab
entries.zh: 修复了清除`/plugin`已安装选项卡上的搜索后光标消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed a mod's `Text` with `wrap="truncate-end"` losing rows on the terminal when it holds a line feed
entries.zh: 修复了带有 `wrap="truncate-end"` 的 mod 的 `Text` 在保存换行符时在终端上丢失行的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/model` showing your saved model as "Default (recommended)": Default now names your plan's default model, and choosing it in the terminal switches you back to that default
entries.zh: 修复了`/model`将您保存的模型显示为“默认（推荐）”的问题：默认现在命名您计划的默认模型，并在终端中选择它会将您切换回默认值

entries.en: Fixed a first skill, command or agent created during a session not being found right away
entries.zh: 修复了无法立即找到会话期间创建的第一个技能、命令或代理的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/clear --help` and other built-in commands running at an idle prompt instead of showing usage; added `/help <command>`
entries.zh: 修复了`/clear --help`和其他内置命令在空闲提示符下运行而不是显示用法的问题；添加了 `/help <命令>`

entries.en: Fixed a half-written reply sitting frozen with no spinner while Claude Code retried after a mid-response server error
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德代码在中间响应服务器错误后重试时，半写回复冻结且没有旋转器的问题

entries.en: Fixed the API retry notice sitting at "Retrying in 0s" during the next attempt, now "retrying…", and the "will retry in" countdown freezing when a reply stalled or with Reduce motion on
entries.zh: 修复了 API 重试通知在下一次尝试期间处于“0 秒内重试”状态，现在“正在重试...”，以及当回复停滞或打开“减少”动作时“将重试”倒计时冻结

entries.en: Fixed the transcript dropping a few rows, or the prompt jumping up, as a reply started streaming
entries.zh: 修复了当回复开始流式传输时，文字记录会丢失几行，或者提示会跳起的问题

entries.en: Fixed a line of a long list or code block going missing from scrollback, and text jumping a row, while a response streams
entries.zh: 修复了长列表或代码块中的一行在回滚时丢失，以及文本在响应流时跳跃一行的问题

entries.en: Fixed a long queued message hiding Claude's reply while it streams, and erasing it from scrollback in the classic renderer
entries.zh: 修复了一条长队消息在流式传输时隐藏克劳德的回复，并在经典渲染器中将其从回滚中删除

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen text jumping when a reply finishes while you're scrolled up or after answering an Edit or Write prompt, and losing your place or jumping turns when resizing
entries.zh: 修复了当您向上滚动或回答“编辑”或“写入”提示后回复完成时全屏文本跳转，以及在调整大小时丢失位置或跳转的问题

entries.en: Fixed the fullscreen transcript going blank when searching or jumping far back, and freezing partway through a fast scroll, in long sessions
entries.zh: 修复了在长时间会话中搜索或向后跳转时全屏文字记录变为空白，以及在快速滚动过程中冻结的问题

entries.en: Fixed the pinned prompt in fullscreen showing an older question while a reply streams, and being copied with the reply when you drag a selection past the top
entries.zh: 修复了全屏固定提示在回复流时显示较旧的问题，以及当您将选择拖过顶部时与回复一起复制的问题

entries.en: Fixed the screen going blank and dropping keys after picking a model in `/model`, and `/model <alias>` and `/effort <level>` briefly hiding the prompt and dropping letters typed right after
entries.zh: 修复了在`/model`中选择模型后屏幕变黑并丢失按键的问题，以及`/model <alias>`和`/effort <level>`短暂隐藏提示并丢失之后键入的字母

entries.en: Fixed the screen scrambling after `/tui default` in a long conversation, or when the `tui` setting changed in another window (anthropics/claude-code#94879)
entries.zh: 修复了长时间对话中`/tui default`之后或在另一个窗口中更改`tui`设置时的屏幕乱码 (anthropics/claude-code#94879)

entries.en: Fixed the screen freezing for seconds when showing long newly created files in the permission prompt and the Ctrl+O transcript
entries.zh: 修复了在权限提示和 Ctrl+O 记录中显示长的新创建文件时屏幕冻结几秒钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed some very long Bash or PowerShell commands freezing the session for seconds
entries.zh: 修复了一些非常长的 Bash 或 PowerShell 命令将会话冻结几秒钟的问题

entries.en: Fixed Shift+Enter or Option+Enter pressed right after a paste sending the prompt instead of adding a new line
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴后立即按下 Shift+Enter 或 Option+Enter 发送提示而不是添加新行的问题

entries.en: Fixed Up, Down, End and mouse clicks putting the cursor on the wrong row of a prompt that wraps
entries.zh: 修复了向上、向下、结束和鼠标单击将光标置于换行提示的错误行上的问题

entries.en: Fixed undo (Ctrl+_) losing the last words typed when pressed after deleting a line or word
entries.zh: 修复了删除行或单词后按下撤消 (Ctrl+_) 时丢失最后输入的单词的问题

entries.en: Fixed code or a diff pasted into a prompt losing its indentation in the transcript, and a pasted diff's added lines showing as removed
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴到提示中的代码或差异在转录中丢失缩进的问题，并且粘贴差异的添加行显示为已删除

entries.en: Fixed `[Image #N]` landing in the middle of a word when typing right after pasting, and a pasted image not being sent after deleting its placeholder and pasting it back with Ctrl+Y
entries.zh: 修复了粘贴后立即输入时`[Image #N]`落在单词中间的问题，以及删除其占位符并使用 Ctrl+Y 将其粘贴回来后未发送粘贴的图像的问题

entries.en: Fixed asterisks disappearing from your own prompts in the transcript, such as `src/**/*.ts` or `2*3*4`
entries.zh: 修复了转录中您自己的提示中星号消失的问题，例如`src/**/*.ts`或`2*3*4`

entries.en: Fixed `claude -p` showing nothing in the terminal while it retried an overloaded or failing API request, or when it failed with its text output redirected or captured
entries.zh: 修复了`claude -p`在重试超载或失败的 API 请求时，或者在其文本输出重定向或捕获失败时在终端中不显示任何内容的问题

entries.en: Fixed Windows paths in Claude's responses losing the backslash before folders like `.claude` or `_build`
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 响应中的 Windows 路径在`.claude`或`_build`等文件夹之前丢失反斜杠的问题

entries.en: Fixed bold text showing as raw `**` in Japanese, Chinese and Korean replies when it starts or ends with punctuation
entries.zh: 修复了日语、中文和韩语回复中以标点符号开头或结尾时显示为原始`**`的粗体文本

entries.en: Fixed `/memory` opening a read-only file with no warning that changes may not save
entries.zh: 修复了`/memory`打开只读文件时没有警告更改可能无法保存的问题

entries.en: Fixed Claude editing `~/.claude/keybindings.json`, which has no effect in Claude Desktop, when asked to change a shortcut there
entries.zh: 修复了克劳德编辑`~/.claude/keybindings.json`的问题，当要求更改那里的快捷方式时，该编辑在克劳德桌面中不起作用

entries.en: Fixed Claude saying that an administrator can turn on Claude in Chrome when your organization's policy disables it, in apps that provide its tools such as Claude Desktop's Code tab
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude 表示，当您的组织的策略禁用 Chrome 时，管理员可以在提供其工具（例如 Claude Desktop 的“代码”选项卡）的应用程序中打开 Claude 的问题

entries.en: Fixed the suggested next prompt sometimes being a bare tag, such as `<signal type="empty" />`
entries.zh: 修复了建议的下一个提示有时是裸标签的问题，例如`<signal type="empty" />`

entries.en: Fixed long command output ending mid-line in the expanded view with no sign it was cut; it now names the saved file
entries.zh: 修复了长命令输出在展开视图中以中线结束且没有被剪切的迹象；它现在命名保存的文件

entries.en: Fixed collapsed tool lines reading "Ran" or "Called" while still asking permission, and "Running…" or "Reading…" again when a panel opened after a call was stopped or refused
entries.zh: 修复了折叠工具行在仍在请求许可的情况下读取“Ran”或“Called”的问题，以及在呼叫停止或拒绝后打开面板时再次“Running...”或“Reading...”的问题

entries.en: Fixed failed, blocked or refused commands looking like passing ones in a collapsed tool line: it now shows "· 1 failed" or says they did not run
entries.zh: 修复了失败、阻止或拒绝的命令，看起来像是在折叠的工具行中传递命令：它现在显示“· 1 失败”或说它们没有运行

entries.en: Fixed the "done" line showing after a turn that failed or was refused at a permission prompt
entries.zh: 修复了在权限提示下失败或被拒绝的回合后显示的“完成”行

entries.en: Fixed failed or refused skill and agent calls still showing "Initializing…"
entries.zh: 修复了失败或拒绝的技能以及代理呼叫仍显示“正在初始化...”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/btw` showing only a lead-in such as "Let me check that file." with no notice when the model tried to use a tool (anthropics/claude-code#90314)
entries.zh: 修复了仅显示导入内容的`/btw`，例如“让我检查该文件”。当模型尝试使用工具时没有任何通知（anthropics/claude-code#90314）

entries.en: Fixed long `/btw` answers looking finished and ignoring PgUp, PgDn, Home, End and the mouse wheel
entries.zh: 修复了长`/btw`答案看起来已完成并忽略 PgUp、PgDn、Home、End 和鼠标滚轮的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/resume` search saying "No sessions match" for older sessions that exist, and a typed number opening a session instead of searching
entries.zh: 修复了`/resume`搜索对存在的较旧会话显示“没有会话匹配”的问题，以及输入数字打开会话而不是搜索的问题

entries.en: Fixed pressing Ctrl+R again in fullscreen prompt search not moving to the next older match
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏提示搜索中再次按 Ctrl+R 不会移至下一个旧匹配的问题

entries.en: Fixed Tab not completing file names without a slash in shell mode (`!`), and completed paths with spaces or shell characters not being quoted
entries.zh: 修复了在 shell 模式下 Tab 无法完成没有斜线的文件名 (`!`) 的问题，以及未用引号引起来的包含空格或 shell 字符的完整路径

entries.en: Fixed a rebound `chat:submit` key doing nothing while the slash command or @ file menu was open
entries.zh: 修复了当斜杠命令或@文件菜单打开时反弹“聊天：提交”键不执行任何操作的问题

entries.en: Fixed holding Esc over typed text opening Rewind after the text was cleared
entries.zh: 修复了在清除文本后按住 Esc 键在键入的文本上打开“倒带”的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc over typed text cancelling a pending `/loop`
entries.zh: 修复了键入文本上的 Esc 取消挂起的`/loop`的问题

entries.en: Fixed "Esc again to clear" staying on screen after a second Esc would no longer clear the prompt
entries.zh: 修复了第二次 Esc 后“再次 Esc 清除”停留在屏幕上将不再清除提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed typing landing in the wrong place in a question's note after going back to it or editing it in an external editor
entries.zh: 修复了返回问题注释或在外部编辑器中编辑问题注释后在问题注释中的错误位置输入登陆的问题

entries.en: Fixed the "paste again to expand" hint hiding the mode and "esc to interrupt" after a paste was sent or deleted
entries.zh: 修复了发送或删除粘贴后“再次粘贴以展开”提示隐藏模式和“ESC 以中断”的问题

entries.en: Fixed "paste again to expand" hiding the middle of a paste longer than 10,000 characters in fullscreen mode, and a prompt collapsing while you type past that length
entries.zh: 修复了“再次粘贴以展开”在全屏模式下隐藏超过 10,000 个字符的粘贴中间部分，以及当您输入超过该长度时提示崩溃的问题

entries.en: Fixed the arrow keys and `q` not working in a pager that `claude --help` is piped to, as in `claude --help | less`
entries.zh: 修复了箭头键和`q`在`claude --help`通过管道传输到的寻呼机中不起作用的问题，如“claude --help |”中所示。少`

entries.en: Fixed Claude Desktop's Code tab blaming the internet connection when a certificate's signature couldn't be verified
entries.zh: 修复了当无法验证证书签名时 Claude Desktop 的“代码”选项卡会指责互联网连接的问题

entries.en: Fixed Web Search showing nothing while its request was being retried
entries.zh: 修复了重试请求时 Web 搜索不显示任何内容的问题

entries.en: Fixed desktop notifications not being sent inside tmux (with `allow-passthrough` on), or to iTerm2 over SSH, on the default setting
entries.zh: 修复了在默认设置下，桌面通知未在 tmux 内发送（启用`allow-passthrough`）或通过 SSH 发送至 iTerm2 的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/copy` and `/export` saying "copied to clipboard" over SSH when the terminal may not have copied anything
entries.zh: 修复了当终端可能没有复制任何内容时通过 SSH 说`/copy`和`/export`“复制到剪贴板”的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/usage-credits` saying "Request sent to your admin" when the request was refused; people who have billing access themselves are now pointed to the usage settings page
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage-credits`在请求被拒绝时显示“请求已发送至您的管理员”的问题；本身具有计费访问权限的人现在会被指向使用设置页面

entries.en: Fixed the transcript share question for Pro and Max users staying open after the next message, `/clear` or `/resume`
entries.zh: 修复了 Pro 和 Max 用户在下一条消息`/clear`或`/resume`后保持打开状态的文字记录共享问题

entries.en: Fixed an upgrade hint appearing under an old usage limit message after the limit had reset
entries.zh: 修复了重置限制后旧使用限制消息下出现的升级提示

entries.en: Fixed the effort level notice reappearing after every permission prompt or dialog, and the usage limit warning and other notices not appearing while the context warning showed
entries.zh: 修复了每次权限提示或对话框后重新出现工作量级别通知，以及在显示上下文警告时不出现使用限制警告和其他通知的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/tui default` saying it had switched back to the classic renderer when a setting kept fullscreen on; after a `/tui` that can't switch, Claude Code now says what keeps the renderer
entries.zh: 修复了`/tui default`，表示当设置保持全屏打开时它已切换回经典渲染器；在无法切换的`/tui`之后，Claude Code 现在会说明是什么保留了渲染器

entries.en: Fixed a new account's first session using a different renderer from later ones
entries.zh: 修复了新帐户的第一个会话使用与后续帐户不同的渲染器的问题

entries.en: Fixed Reduce motion and Show tips in `/config` applying only to the current folder
entries.zh: 修复了仅适用于当前文件夹的`/config`中的减少运动和显示提示

entries.en: Fixed typing and spinners redrawing the whole pane in tmux 3.7
entries.zh: 修复了 tmux 3.7 中打字和旋转器重绘整个窗格的问题

entries.en: Fixed Option+T typing † instead of toggling thinking over SSH from iTerm2 when Option isn't set as Meta
entries.zh: 修复了 Option+T 键入 †，而不是在 Option 未设置为 Meta 时从 iTerm2 切换对 SSH 的思考

entries.en: Fixed `/terminal-setup` not naming the tmux settings that Shift+Enter needs, and promising Shift+Enter in Windows Terminal before 1.25, where it sends the prompt
entries.zh: 修复了 `/terminal-setup` 未命名 Shift+Enter 所需的 tmux 设置，并承诺在 1.25 之前的 Windows 终端中使用 Shift+Enter 发送提示

entries.en: Fixed Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) terminals showing a finished turn after idle compaction, or no status for background sessions opened with `claude agents`, `claude attach` or `--resume`
entries.zh: 修复了程序状态协议 (OSC 7501) 终端在空闲压缩后显示已完成的回合，或者使用“claude Agents”、“claude Attach”或`--resume`打开的后台会话没有状态的问题

entries.en: Fixed terminals that support the Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) not seeing Claude Code as waiting on you while the folder trust prompt is open (anthropics/claude-code#105801)
entries.zh: 修复了支持程序状态协议 (OSC 7501) 的终端在文件夹信任提示打开时看不到 Claude Code 正在等待您的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#105801)

entries.en: Fixed the terminal progress bar showing Claude as working while it waited for your answer or was suspended with Ctrl+Z, and disappearing in Ghostty after 15 seconds while Claude was still working
entries.zh: 修复了终端进度条在等待您的答复时显示 Claude 正在工作或使用 Ctrl+Z 暂停，并在 Claude 仍在工作时 15 秒后在 Ghostty 中消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed fullscreen giving no sign that a permission prompt or question was waiting while you were scrolled up
entries.zh: 修复了全屏向上滚动时没有任何迹象表明权限提示或问题正在等待的问题

entries.en: Fixed the fullscreen tool group headline naming a finished or queued call instead of the running one
entries.zh: 修复了全屏工具组标题命名已完成或排队的呼叫而不是正在运行的呼叫

entries.en: Fixed finished tool groups in fullscreen counting a search or listing also as a shell command, and the tool timer there counting time at a permission prompt or queued behind another command
entries.zh: 修复了全屏中已完成的工具组也将搜索或列表也作为 shell 命令进行计数，以及工具计时器在权限提示下计算时间或在另一个命令后面排队的问题

entries.en: Fixed a multi-line shell command filling the screen in fullscreen while it runs
entries.zh: 修复了多行 shell 命令在运行时以全屏方式填充屏幕的问题

entries.en: Fixed `!` shell commands showing no output for their first three seconds
entries.zh: 修复了`!` shell 命令在前三秒内没有显示输出的问题

entries.en: Fixed a running command showing no output or timer when its collapsed row was clicked open in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏模式下单击打开折叠行时运行命令不显示输出或计时器的问题

entries.en: Fixed the jump-to-bottom pill disappearing in fullscreen while more of the reply was still below
entries.zh: 修复了跳至底部药丸在全屏下消失而更多回复仍在下方的问题

entries.en: Fixed the prompt disappearing in short fullscreen windows while a survey or notice showed above it
entries.zh: 修复了提示在短全屏窗口中消失而上方显示调查或通知的问题

entries.en: Fixed the custom status line disappearing and the screen jumping on Ctrl+C, in `!` shell mode and while pasting an image
entries.zh: 修复了在 `!` shell 模式下以及粘贴图像时自定义状态行消失和按 Ctrl+C 时屏幕跳转的问题

entries.en: Fixed a custom status line keeping its old width, folder and session name after a terminal resize, `/cd` or `/rename` (anthropics/claude-code#107291)
entries.zh: 修复了自定义状态行在终端调整大小、`/cd`或`/rename`后保留其旧宽度、文件夹和会话名称的问题 (anthropics/claude-code#107291)

entries.en: Fixed "esc to interrupt" missing beside a custom status line and showing while Esc would go to a panel or footer item
entries.zh: 修复了自定义状态行旁边缺少“ESC 中断”并在 Esc 转到面板或页脚项目时显示的问题

entries.en: Fixed mouse escape codes being typed into the shell after exiting fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了退出全屏模式后在 shell 中键入鼠标转义代码的问题

entries.en: Fixed the Ctrl+Z message printing over the prompt box outside fullscreen
entries.zh: 修复了全屏之外的提示框上打印 Ctrl+Z 消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude logs` painting over and mixing with what was already in the terminal
entries.zh: 修复了“克劳德日志”的绘制并与终端中已有的内容混合

entries.en: Fixed the spinner tip flashing back and the screen bouncing as a reply finished
entries.zh: 修复了回复完成时旋转器尖端闪烁和屏幕弹跳的问题

entries.en: Fixed the "Reading 1 file…" line blinking out and the prompt jumping when a tool call finished streaming
entries.zh: 修复了工具调用完成流式传输时“正在读取 1 个文件...”行闪烁和提示跳转的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `claude --resume` session preview being garbled and not scrolling in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了`claude --resume`会话预览出现乱码并且在全屏模式下不滚动的问题

entries.en: Fixed Esc not leaving the "Connect to your IDE automatically?" question in `/ide`, where Ctrl+C twice quit Claude Code
entries.zh: 修复了 Esc 未离开“自动连接到您的 IDE？”的问题`/ide` 中的问题，其中 Ctrl+C 两次退出 Claude Code

entries.en: Fixed first-run terminal setup saying nothing about what it changed or could not set up
entries.zh: 修复了首次运行终端设置未说明其更改或无法设置的内容

entries.en: Fixed `/status` showing installation warnings twice
entries.zh: 修复了`/status`显示安装警告两次的问题

entries.en: Fixed the footer's PR badge showing the previous branch's pull request after switching branches
entries.zh: 修复了页脚的 PR 徽章在切换分支后显示上一个分支的拉取请求的问题

entries.en: Fixed the "Pushed to" summary naming the fetched branch when a command fetched or pulled first, and "Merged PR" or "Closed PR" showing when `gh` refused the action and the exit code was hidden
entries.zh: 修复了当首先提取或拉取命令时命名提取分支的“推送到”摘要，以及当`gh`拒绝操作且隐藏退出代码时显示的“合并 PR”或“关闭 PR”

entries.en: Fixed URLs that wrap over several lines not being clickable in terminals with link support that Claude Code doesn't recognize, and labeled links in the Rex terminal
entries.zh: 修复了在具有 Claude Code 无法识别的链接支持的终端中无法单击的多行换行 URL，以及 Rex 终端中的标记链接

entries.en: Fixed the Ctrl+O transcript hinting Ctrl+B to background a command in fullscreen, where it pages up, and showing no sign that Claude is still working
entries.zh: 修复了 Ctrl+O 脚本提示 Ctrl+B 在全屏中将命令设置为背景的问题，该命令会向上翻页，并且没有显示克劳德仍在工作的迹象

entries.en: Fixed the Ctrl+R search, the model picker, plan approval, question previews, background shell output and `/plugin` install choices being cut off in short fullscreen windows
entries.zh: 修复了 Ctrl+R 搜索、模型选择器、计划批准、问题预览、后台 shell 输出和`/plugin`安装选项在短全屏窗口中被切断的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/context` grid, API errors such as "Credit balance too low", "Waiting for API response" and retry notices, "esc to interrupt" and "Interrupted" being cut off or jumbled in narrow terminals
entries.zh: 修复了 `/context` 网格、API 错误，例如“信用余额过低”、“等待 API 响应”和重试通知、“esc 中断”和“中断”在狭窄终端中被切断或混乱

entries.en: Fixed wide tables breaking apart in plans and subagent prompts, cutting short words in half beside a long cell, and showing stray words and blank rows when drawn as label and value lists
entries.zh: 修复了宽表在计划和子代理提示中分开、将长单元格旁边的短单词切成两半以及在绘制为标签和值列表时显示杂散单词和空白行的问题

entries.en: Fixed code keywords, added diff lines, the slow-reply spinner and "thinking" being hard to read in some themes and terminals
entries.zh: 修复了代码关键字、添加了差异行、缓慢回复的旋转器以及在某些主题和终端中难以阅读的“思考”

entries.en: Fixed code in diffs and file previews being invisible when the theme and the terminal background differ
entries.zh: 修复了主题和终端背景不同时差异和文件预览中的代码不可见的问题

entries.en: Fixed the unused part of `/usage` bars looking full in the light and ANSI themes
entries.zh: 修复了`/usage`栏未使用的部分在灯光和 ANSI 主题中看起来很完整的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `/effort` slider ignoring mouse clicks in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了`/effort`滑块在全屏模式下忽略鼠标点击的问题

entries.en: Fixed text being drawn out of place after skin-tone or joined emoji, symbols such as ✌ and ☝, and Hindi, Tamil and other Indic vowel signs in terminals that draw them wider
entries.zh: 修复了终端中的肤色或连接表情符号、✌和☝等符号以及印地语、泰米尔语和其他印度语元音符号后绘制不正确的文本，这些符号将它们拉得更宽

entries.en: Fixed joined emoji pushing rows out of place in GNU screen
entries.zh: 修复了连接的表情符号在 GNU 屏幕中将行推错位的问题

entries.en: Fixed the last item of JSON lists and right-aligned numbers losing their indent in command and tool output
entries.zh: 修复了 JSON 列表的最后一项和右对齐数字在命令和工具输出中丢失缩进的问题

entries.en: Fixed diffs numbering "No newline at end of file" as a line of code, which shifted the line numbers after it
entries.zh: 修复了将“文件末尾无换行符”编号为代码行的差异编号，这会移动其后的行号

entries.en: Fixed long single-line messages showing "(0 lines hidden)" instead of how much text is hidden
entries.zh: 修复了长单行消息显示“（隐藏 0 行）”而不是隐藏了多少文本的问题

entries.en: Fixed notebook edits showing no tool row when Claude left out the cell type or deleted a cell, and showing `@undefined` when inserting a cell at the top
entries.zh: 修复了当克劳德遗漏单元格类型或删除单元格时笔记本编辑不显示工具行，以及在顶部插入单元格时显示`@undefined`的问题

entries.en: Fixed the "Switch model?" and "Change effort level?" questions showing no key hints
entries.zh: 修复了“切换型号？”和“改变努力水平？”没有显示关键提示的问题

entries.en: Fixed the `?` shortcuts list running its columns together in narrow terminals and being cut off at the bottom in short fullscreen windows
entries.zh: 修复了`?`快捷方式列表在狭窄的终端中一起运行其列并在短的全屏窗口中在底部被切断的问题

entries.en: Fixed leftover hint text in screen reader mode on macOS and Linux after closing the `/permissions` search when the rule list was taller than the terminal
entries.zh: 修复了当规则列表高于终端时关闭`/permissions`搜索后 macOS 和 Linux 上屏幕阅读器模式下的剩余提示文本

entries.en: Removed the tmux notice that said the mouse wheel needs `set -g mouse on` in fullscreen; the wheel scrolls without it
entries.zh: 删除了 tmux 提示，全屏时鼠标滚轮需要 `set -g mouse on`；没有它滚轮就会滚动

entries.en: Removed the spinner tip that suggested `/clear` 30 minutes into a running turn
entries.zh: 删除了在运行转弯 30 分钟后建议`/clear`的旋转提示

entries.en: Remote Control: Fixed a session disconnecting mid-reply when the server was briefly unavailable
entries.zh: 远程控制：修复了服务器短暂不可用时会话在回复中断开连接的问题

entries.en: Remote Control: Fixed the QR code in `/remote-control` being cut off in short terminal windows such as 80×24
entries.zh: 远程控制：修复了`/remote-control`中的二维码在短终端窗口（例如80×24）中被切断的问题

entries.en: Remote Control: Fixed terminal sessions showing as idle on your phone while background subagents were still running; Stop on your phone or the web now ends them together with the turn
entries.zh: 远程控制：修复了当后台子代理仍在运行时终端会话在手机上显示为空闲的问题；停止在你的手机或网络上，现在将它们与转弯一起结束

entries.en: Windows: Improved the speed of a session's first Bash command by about a second
entries.zh: Windows：将会话第一个 Bash 命令的速度提高了约一秒

entries.en: Remote Control: Changed how it connects through a proxy: requests now use a CONNECT tunnel, so a proxy that refuses CONNECT stops Remote Control with an error
entries.zh: 远程控制：更改了通过代理连接的方式：请求现在使用 CONNECT 隧道，因此拒绝 CONNECT 的代理会停止远程控制并出现错误

entries.en: Remote Control: Changed the session debug logs written under `--verbose` to go to `~/.claude/child-logs/`
entries.zh: 远程控制：将`--verbose`下写入的会话调试日志更改为`~/.claude/child-logs/`

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed Linux and macOS sessions with no `gh` to get a built-in `gh api` by default, via Anthropic, which adds their GitHub sign-in, if any; `--use-anthropic-gh false` turns it off
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：更改了没有`gh`的 Linux 和 macOS 会话，默认情况下通过 Anthropic 获取内置`gh api`，这会添加 GitHub 登录（如果有）； `--use-anthropic-gh false` 将其关闭

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a `claudeCode.promptSuggestions` setting that turns prompt suggestions off
entries.zh: [VSCode] 添加了`claudeCode.promptSuggestions`设置，可关闭提示建议

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Rewind code to here" in a forked conversation sometimes undoing one turn too many and deleting files created in that turn
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了分叉对话中的“将代码倒回此处”有时会撤消一轮过多并删除该轮中创建的文件的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the Sandbox dialog creating empty files and folders in the home directory and the project's `.git` folder while the sandbox is off
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了沙箱关闭时沙箱对话框在主目录和项目的`.git`文件夹中创建空文件和文件夹的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the saved sign-in being lost on some networks
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了保存的登录在某些网络上丢失的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed sign-in ending when a verification code, a web address or a code from another sign-in attempt is pasted; the panel now says what to paste instead
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了粘贴验证码、网址或其他登录尝试的代码时登录结束的问题；面板现在显示要粘贴的内容

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen showing briefly each time a panel or window opened while signed in to Console without an API key
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了在没有 API 密钥的情况下登录控制台时每次打开面板或窗口时短暂显示的登录屏幕

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the usage-limit banner's "Request more" button for Team and Enterprise members coming back after each press without sending anything, after you signed in again during a session
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了使用限制横幅的“请求更多”按钮，以便团队和企业成员在会话期间再次登录后每次按下后返回而不发送任何内容

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed `/ide` in a second Claude Code session silently losing the editor connection back to the first session; the newest connection now wins and the displaced session shows how to switch back
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了第二个 Claude Code 会话中的 `/ide` 默默地失去了与第一个会话的编辑器连接；现在最新的连接获胜，替换的会话显示如何切换回来

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed saved memories not being listed in the Memory dialog, or RAM use growing without end, when the memory folder held symlink loops, and a hang when it held a named pipe
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了当内存文件夹持有符号链接循环时，保存的内存未在“内存”对话框中列出，或者 RAM 使用量无休止地增长，以及当它持有命名管道时挂起的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a running command's live output stopping after one failed read
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了正在运行的命令的实时输出在一次读取失败后停止的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed "Open in Terminal" showing only the shell's error when `claude` could not be started: in bash, zsh, fish and Git Bash, a notice now explains why and links to the install guide
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了“在终端中打开”在无法启动 `claude` 时仅显示 shell 的错误：在 bash、zsh、fish 和 Git Bash 中，现在有一条通知解释了原因并链接到安装指南

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the panel showing no "Open artifact" link after Claude publishes an artifact
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了 Claude 发布工件后面板不显示“打开工件”链接的问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed the prompt suggestion hiding the "attach selected text" hint while the chat panel is unfocused
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了聊天面板未聚焦时隐藏“附加所选文本”提示的提示建议

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed buttons with no visible border in the high-contrast themes, and the dark welcome art on the sign-in screen in Light High Contrast
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复了高对比度主题中没有可见边框的按钮以及浅高对比度登录屏幕上的深色欢迎艺术

entries.en: [VSCode] Improved Edit and Write speed: no wait for new problems on files that are not open in a tab when the editor has been reporting none for such files
entries.zh: [VSCode] 改进的编辑和写入速度：当编辑器未报告未在选项卡中打开的文件时，无需等待此类文件出现新问题

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed a running command's live output in the chat to look like the command card's OUT row
entries.zh: [VSCode] 更改了聊天中正在运行的命令的实时输出，使其看起来像命令卡的 OUT 行

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the text of extension errors in event listeners, views and activation to stay out of the editor's own error telemetry
entries.zh: [VSCode] 更改了事件侦听器、视图和激活中的扩展错误文本，以远离编辑器自己的错误遥测
